transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: hello thank you for calling S-Net technical support this is hannah speaking how can i help you today

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: hi hannah my name is oluwaseun i really need help with our new wi-fi 6 router because our smart heating controller and nursery camera keep dropping offline

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: okay oluwaseun before i look into your router settings can you confirm your postcode home address and the four digit security PIN on the account

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah sure it is 29 beechwood close Manchester M14 6HT and the PIN is 5518

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: and can you also confirm the answer to your security question on the profile which is the city you were born in

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: lagos

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: right i have your account open here for 29 beechwood close tell me what is happening with the devices

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: well we have a six day old newborn baby in the house and there is a freezing cold snap outside right now and the heating keeps cutting out because the thermostat loses wi-fi

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: the router broadcasts a unified wireless signal by default so tell me which specific smart devices are failing to stay connected

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: it's honestly making my wife and me so anxious with the baby's room getting cold at night the thermostat is a Hive Mini and the camera is an Owlet Cam 2

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: so to restate the technical problem your S-Net Wi-Fi 6 hub is using automatic band steering on a single combined network name which is knocking your 2.4 gigahertz heating receiver and baby camera offline

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes that sounds like what is happening they connect for maybe ten minutes after i reboot the router and then both lights go flashing amber

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: let me ask a few diagnostic questions about how they are set up how far away are the receiver unit and the nursery camera from the main S-Net hub

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: the router is in the downstairs hall the boiler receiver is in the kitchen just four metres away and the nursery is directly above the hall upstairs

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: and when you try to reconnect them on your phone app what exact error message or status code does the app display on screen

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: it says cannot join network authentication timeout or unsupported frequency band and then it fails to get an IP

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: what wireless security mode did you see when you selected your home network name on the phone was it showing WPA3 personal or WPA2

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: uh on my phone settings next to S-Net-Home-884A it says WPA2 slash WPA3 transitional mode

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: and have you plugged any third party mesh boosters or wireless extenders into the wall sockets around the house

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: no nothing like that just the white S-Net Wi-Fi 6 router that the engineer installed on thursday

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: what hardware revision is printed on the back label of the S-Net Smart Hub 6X

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: let me look at the back sticker... it says Smart Hub 6X hardware revision B2

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: and when the devices drop off do your mobile phones or laptops lose wi-fi at the same time or do they stay connected

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: our phones and my laptop stay connected fine on the wi-fi it's only the heating receiver and the baby monitor that drop off

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: have you tried turning off mobile data and private wi-fi MAC randomisation on your phone while running the device pairing wizard

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah i switched mobile data off when i tried pairing them at three in the morning but after ten minutes they still got kicked off

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: are both devices running on battery power or wired into wall mains adapters

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: the boiler receiver is wired directly into the spur next to the combi boiler and the nursery camera is plugged into the wall socket by the cot

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: right i can see the issue on the remote diagnostic dashboard your router has Smart Band Steering and 802.11ax Protected Management Frames enabled on the single SSID

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: wait what does Protected Management Frames mean why would the new router stop our heating from working when the old router worked fine

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: because older 2.4 gigahertz radio chips inside household sensors cannot handle WPA3 management frame negotiation or 5 gigahertz band handoff requests

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: nobody told us that when we upgraded to the Wi-Fi 6 package last week we were freezing at three in the morning trying to pair it

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, if you'd actually read the quick-start booklet that came in the box, you'd know IoT devices need a dedicated 2.4 gigahertz SSID.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: excuse me we just brought a newborn baby home from hospital we haven't exactly been sitting around reading router booklets cover to cover

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i am just stating that the setup instructions for smart home accessories are printed on page four of the leaflet inside the router packaging

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: look can you just fix it from your end so our heating stays on and the baby monitor doesn't keep disconnecting

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: yes i will configure the wireless radios remotely from my console right now so you do not have to log into the admin page yourself

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay thank you what are you going to change on it

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i am going to disable band steering split the 2.4 gigahertz and 5 gigahertz radios into two separate network names and set the 2.4 gigahertz band to WPA2 only

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: will our phones and laptops still work on the fast wi-fi if you split them

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: yes your phones and laptops can stay on the main S-Net-Home-884A network which will run on 5 gigahertz while the heating and camera use a dedicated 2.4G network

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay that makes sense how long does that take to apply

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: it takes about a minute to push the TR-069 radio profile please bear with me while i apply the split SSID settings and reboot the wireless module

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: thank you for holding oluwaseun the wireless radio module on your hub has restarted and the new configuration is active

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i saw the wi-fi light on the router blink for a few seconds and now it is back to solid white

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what brand of smart thermostat are you trying to pair to the network?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: uh i already told you earlier in the call that it's a Hive Mini thermostat

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: right i have created a second wireless network called S-Net-Home-884A-2.4G with the exact same wi-fi password as your main network for the Hive Mini and the camera

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: let me check the wi-fi list on my phone right now yeah i can see S-Net-Home-884A-2.4G showing up with full signal bars

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i also locked that 2.4 gigahertz radio onto fixed channel 6 at 20 megahertz bandwidth and switched off Protected Management Frames so the smart devices stay locked on

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: great let me open the nursery camera app first and switch it over to that new 2.4G network name

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: go ahead and connect the nursery camera first and tell me when the status light changes

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay scanning QR code on the Owlet base station now... connecting to S-Net-Home-884A-2.4G... oh nice the light on the camera just turned solid blue and live video is up

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: right i can see the camera MAC address registered on the 2.4 gigahertz DHCP lease table with a strong minus 48 dBm signal level

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: that connected in like five seconds whereas earlier it timed out every single time

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: now put the Hive Mini hub and receiver into pairing mode and connect it to the S-Net-Home-884A-2.4G network

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i'm in the kitchen pressing the button on the receiver and selecting S-Net-Home-884A-2.4G in the Hive app on my phone

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i am watching the router's client association table from here so let me know as soon as the app finishes joining

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: it says joining wi-fi network... obtaining IP address... connected to cloud! and the status light on the boiler receiver has just gone solid green

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i can see the device online in the router table now and i am setting a static DHCP IP reservation for both the thermostat and the baby camera

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: what does the static IP reservation do for them

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: it guarantees that whenever your router reboots or renews leases the heating controller and nursery camera always receive the exact same local IP numbers without any drop

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh brilliant i just bumped the target temperature up to 20.5 degrees on the app and i literally just heard the boiler flame fire up in the kitchen

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: let me also run a quick stability check on both connections to make sure there are no deauthentication packets or band handoff retries occurring

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah please check that because before it would drop off after a few minutes when we walked into another room

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: both devices have maintained zero packet retries and zero roaming requests over the past two minutes because band steering is completely disabled on the 2.4G radio

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: and both my phone and my wife's phone can stay on the normal 5G network name and still control the heating app right

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: yes because both wireless bands bridge into the exact same local LAN subnet so your phone on 5 gigahertz can talk directly to the devices on 2.4 gigahertz

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: let me test turning my phone back onto the main S-Net-Home-884A network... yeah the live video stream from the crib camera still loads straight away and the thermostat shows online

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: i have saved this configuration permanently to your S-Net cloud router profile and disabled overnight channel hopping on the 2.4G band

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: that is a massive relief now that the heating is actually running again and the camera is staying solid

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: can you confirm that both your smart heating thermostat and the baby monitor are staying connected and working properly for you now oluwaseun

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes both the Hive Mini and the baby monitor are showing solid green and blue lights and the heating is warming up the house now

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: is there anything else you need me to check on your broadband connection today

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: no that's everything sorted now thanks for fixing the router settings

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: thank you for choosing S-Net oluwaseun goodbye

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: bye
